name: Night of the Zealot
description: The introductory campaign for Arkham Horror: The Card Game, included in the Core Set. Investigate strange occurrences in Arkham as cultists threaten to tear open a rift between worlds.

scenarios.name: The Gathering
scenarios.description: You are barely settled in for the evening when you hear the sound of strange chanting coming from your parlor. Rushing to investigate, you find a gate has opened in the floor, and otherworldly creatures pour through.

scenarios.name: The Midnight Masks
scenarios.description: The citizens of Arkham are in danger. Cultists have infiltrated the town, hiding behind masks and false identities. You must uncover them before midnight.

scenarios.name: The Devourer Below
scenarios.description: The ritual must be stopped. You venture into the woods south of Arkham, where the cult prepares to summon an Ancient One from beyond the veil.
